Package com.smartlostfound.storage

Class CsvItemStorageService

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.storage.CsvItemStorageService
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemStorageService
public class CsvItemStorageService extends Object implements ItemStorageService
Robust CSV implementation of ItemStorageService. Implements RFC-4180 compliant parsing and serialization with support for quoted strings, embedded commas, and multiline descriptions. Handles polymorphic persistence of LostItem and FoundItem.
